+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .termui import pause
+
+
+def stderr_pause(info: str | None = None, err: bool = True) -> None:
+    """Like :func:`click.pause`, but writes the message to ``stderr`` by
+    default, keeping it out of ``stdout`` when output is piped.
+
+    :param info: The message to print before pausing. Defaults to
+        ``"Press any key to continue..."``.
+    :param err: if set to message goes to ``stderr`` instead of
+                ``stdout``, the same as with echo.
+    """
+    pause(info=info, err=err)
diff --git a/tests/test_stderr_pause.py b/tests/test_stderr_pause.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..91add25
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_stderr_pause.py
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+import click.termui
+from click.stderr_pause import stderr_pause
+
+
+def test_stderr_pause_defaults_to_stderr(capfd, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.termui, "isatty", lambda x: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.termui, "getchar", lambda: " ")
+
+    stderr_pause("Pause to stderr")
+    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
+    assert out == ""
+    assert err == "Pause to stderr\n"
+
+    stderr_pause("Pause to stdout", err=False)
+    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
+    assert out == "Pause to stdout\n"
+    assert err == ""
+
+    stderr_pause()
+    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
+    assert out == ""
+    assert err == "Press any key to continue...\n"
+
+    stderr_pause("")
+    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
+    assert out == ""
+    assert err == ""
+
+
+def test_stderr_pause_ignores_interrupt(capfd, monkeypatch):
+    def raise_interrupt():
+        raise KeyboardInterrupt()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.termui, "isatty", lambda x: True)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.termui, "getchar", raise_interrupt)
+
+    stderr_pause("Pause")
+    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
+    assert out == ""
+    assert err == "Pause\n"
+
+
+def test_stderr_pause_not_a_tty(capfd, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(click.termui, "isatty", lambda x: False)
+    stderr_pause("Pause")
+    out, err = capfd.readouterr()
+    assert out == ""
+    assert err == ""
notes:

Added tests covering stderr default, err=False, default/empty info, KeyboardInterrupt, and non-tty.
